- Para saberlo, corré esta consulta, adaptando los nombres de columna:

```sql
SELECT status, count(*), min(created_at), max(created_at)
FROM tool_usage_log
WHERE workspace = 'pldistribucion'
  AND tool = 'odoo_report'
  AND created_at >= '2026-11-18 13:42:00+00'
  AND created_at <  '2026-11-18 15:00:00+00'
GROUP BY status;
```
